title: Install {name}
body: Open it from your home screen like an app. Full screen, fast, no app store needed.

ios-safari: Tap the Share button {share} at the bottom of Safari.
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen” {add}.
ios-other: Tap the Share button {share} in the address bar.
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen” {add}.
android: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
desktop: Click the install icon {install} at the right of the address bar.
Or open the browser menu {menu} and choose “Install {name}…”.
mac-safari: In the menu bar, open File.

store.title: Get the FeelReels app
store.text: Watch offline, get new-episode alerts and keep your unlocks on every device.
store.webText: No store needed — add FeelReels to your home screen in three taps.
